# Vendored xterm.js assets

These browser assets are copied from the published npm packages and are served
locally so the AxonOS viewer does not require a third-party CDN at runtime.

- `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0 (`xterm.mjs`, `xterm.css`, and source map)
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0 (`addon-fit.mjs` and source map)

The corresponding MIT license files are included alongside the assets.
